lead: A case that reaches an instance only through a `?T`-returning member counts as asking that class nothing.
body: `Attribution::holders` takes the top-level return type alone, so a case whose only door is `Core\Reflect::forClass` (which answers `?Core\Reflect\ClassInfo`) holds no class, every `->member(` in it attributes to nobody, and a new member reads as `asked by 0 case(s)` however many cases call it. Name the class in a comment — or reach it through a member returning the bare `Instance` — and the same cases count.
